meta.notes: package = FightEngine.predict defaults (blend P(win) from the stack block chosen by lineKind; method x round = mrWeight x rescaled simulator cells + (1 - mrWeight) x rescaled S (SM with a close); calibrated interval) with tools/predictrec.js inputs; lineKind close/open fall back to none without that line. Benchmarks: market_close = market.json p_power_close; market_open = p_novig_open; ml_lr_walkforward = blindtest.json ml_lr (refit before each card; the package's `ml` expert); ml_lr_static = ml.json lr (trained through 2023); ml2_lr = ml2.json (static fit < 2024); elo_walkforward = blindtest.json elo; model_S / model_SM = methodround.json cells (fit through the previous year), P(A) = A cells / (A + B). Winner metrics on decisive fights with clip 1e-4.
